description.value:
You scatter a cluster of mass-effect kinetic charges across a wide area, creating a rapid chain of biotic detonations on impact.

Choose a point within 60 feet. All creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-foot burst} centered on that point must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-cluster-grenade] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[force]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[force]] damage and is pushed 5 feet outward from the burst center.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[force]] damage, is pushed 10 feet outward from the burst center, and is knocked prone.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
